cases.name: empty
cases.description: No events: no inputs, every pillar null at coverage 0, unified null.

cases.name: nback_r16
cases.description: R16 n-back: rule-stream d prime, switch cost, off-rule lure_stream events ignored.

cases.name: nback_parity
cases.description: R16 parity rule: scored on the symbol stream (RULE_STREAM parity -> symbol).

cases.name: nback_offrule_press_on_target
cases.description: Target trials where an off-rule press made the rule event wrong: misses, not hit plus false alarm.

cases.name: nback_offstream_error_only
cases.description: Off-rule events wrong while rule events are right: ErrorRecovery reads the rule stream only (R16).

cases.name: nback_chance_nonresponder
cases.description: Never presses: d prime floored at 0, switch cost gated to 0, task left out of ErrorRecovery.

cases.name: nback_unknown_rule
cases.description: Rules outside NBACK_RULE_STREAM fall back to stream === rule (strict: true !== 1).

cases.name: error_recovery_stroop_chance_nback_counted
cases.description: ErrorRecovery leaves out the Stroop task played at chance and still counts the n-back task.

cases.name: stroop
cases.description: Stroop RT cost on correct trials, gated by accuracy above chance; SST_SSRT proxy.

cases.name: stroop_at_chance
cases.description: Stroop at exactly 1 in 4 accuracy: gate 0, so ANT_Conflict 0 although an RT cost exists.

cases.name: stroop_all_wrong
cases.description: No correct Stroop trial: no cost to measure, ANT_Conflict 0 over every trial.

cases.name: tower
cases.description: Tower: execution ratio, planning share and speed, a missing planning time, an unsolved problem.

cases.name: matrix_only_below_coverage
cases.description: Matrix alone: FluidMatrices is 0.25 of focus, below the 0.3 coverage, so focus is null.

cases.name: fluid_matrix_relational
cases.description: Matrix accuracy averaged with hop-weighted relational accuracy.

cases.name: mst
cases.description: MST LDI: P(similar | lure) - P(similar | new); timeouts count as not similar.

cases.name: ufov_two_tasks
cases.description: UFOV: two tasks, thresholds averaged; peripheral accuracy for ANT_Orienting.

cases.name: rotation_only
cases.description: Mental rotation feeds no pillar input, only ErrorRecovery.

cases.name: full_session
cases.description: All 8 exercises in one session: every sourceable input and all five pillars.

cases.name: duplicates
cases.description: A full session with retried batches (repeated rows): every repeat is counted once.

cases.name: fuzz_81
cases.description: Seeded mixed session at varied skill levels.

cases.name: fuzz_82
cases.description: Seeded mixed session at varied skill levels.

cases.name: fuzz_83
cases.description: Seeded mixed session at varied skill levels.

cases.name: stop_signal
cases.description: Stop Light: SSRT by integration (omissions -> slowest go RT, type-6 quantile at P(respond|signal)) minus mean SSD, times the go gate.

cases.name: stop_signal_all_respond
cases.description: Stop Light pressing on every stop sign: P(respond|signal) = 1 > 0.75, excluded, so no SST_SSRT (and no Stroop proxy either).

cases.name: stop_signal_race_violation
cases.description: Stop Light whose signal-respond RTs are not faster than go RTs: the race check excludes it.

cases.name: stop_signal_nonresponder
cases.description: Stop Light never pressed: go gate 0, so SST_SSRT 0 over the stop trials; the task is left out of ErrorRecovery.

cases.name: pal_full
cases.description: Pair Finder: first-attempt hits over pal_total, chance-corrected for 1 in 8 boxes; retries do not count.

cases.name: pal_failed_early
cases.description: Pair Finder ending on a failed third attempt: unreached stages count as missed.

cases.name: flanker
cases.description: Arrow Focus: flanker RT cost on correct trials (200 ms -> 0), times the gate (accuracy - 1/2) / (1/2).

cases.name: flanker_over_stroop
cases.description: Arrow Focus and Color Clash together: ANT_Conflict from the flanker; Stroop still stands in for SSRT.

cases.name: flanker_at_chance
cases.description: Arrow Focus at exactly half right: gate 0, ANT_Conflict 0 although a cost exists; left out of ErrorRecovery.

cases.name: full_session_new_exercises
cases.description: All 11 exercises: every input but DDM_Caution, Deep Memory at coverage 1.
